jobs.description:

A dynamic and fast-paced environment where inclusion, learning and collaboration are key to success

Ongoing training and development to help you grow your skills and career

A safe, clean and fun workplace

Join the mission. Apply today!

jobs.occupation: Software Developer Consultant at Codic Consulting
jobs.description:
About the opportunity
Are you an experienced software developer looking for new challenges?
At Codic Consulting, we work with some of Gothenburg’s leading technology companies across industries such as aviation and automotive. We are looking for skilled software developers who enjoy solving complex problems, building reliable software, and continuously developing their technical expertise.
As a consultant at Codic, you will have the opportunity to work on challenging assignments involving software development, cloud technologies, system integrations, and modern software solutions. Your assignments will depend on your technical background, experience, and interests.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for experienced software developers with at least five years of professional experience.
Ideally, you have experience in several of the following areas:
Software development using Python, Java, or C#/.NET
Backend development, APIs, and system integrations
Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
Microservices and distributed systems
Databases and data management
Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD
Agile software development

Experience from industries such as aviation or automotive is considered an advantage but is not required.
We value technical curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with others.
Professional proficiency in English is required.
Why join Codic?
Codic Consulting is a small and responsive IT consultancy based in Gothenburg, Sweden.
With us, you get the best of both worlds: the opportunity to work on international projects at some of the region’s leading technology companies while being part of a close-knit consultancy with colleagues from around the world.
We believe that professional development, work-life balance, and a supportive working environment are essential for long-term success.
As part of Codic, we offer:
Competitive salary and employment conditions covered by Swedish collective agreements
Annual wellness allowance of 5,000 SEK
Professional development allowance of up to 25,000 SEK or four days per year
Regular one-on-one meetings with your manager
Company bike benefit
Access to technical equipment and opportunities to develop your own projects
Social activities, technical discussions, and team events

Relocation to Sweden
We welcome applications from experienced software developers living outside Sweden.
For suitable candidates, we can provide support throughout the relocation process, including guidance on practical and administrative matters related to moving to Gothenburg.
Interested?
If you’re passionate about software development and interested in joining a consultancy that values both technical excellence and its people, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: R&D Engineer – Analytical Science - Consultant Assignment in Uppsala
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for analytical science, laboratory-based research and material characterization? Would you like to apply your scientific expertise in an innovative R&D environment within the life science industry?
SallyQ is currently looking for an R&D Engineer with experience in analytical techniques and biopolymer characterization for a consultancy assignment with an established life science company in Uppsala.
About the role
In this role, you will join an analytical R&D team providing scientific expertise and analytical support across product development, manufacturing and quality control.
You will work in a collaborative and technically advanced environment, contributing to the development and improvement of products and processes used in biopharmaceutical manufacturing.
Cross-functional collaboration will be an important part of your role, offering opportunities to apply your analytical expertise to a variety of scientific and technical challenges.
Key responsibilities
Participate in R&D projects focused on new product development and continuous product and process improvement.

Perform laboratory-based analyses using chromatography and other analytical techniques.

Contribute to analytical method development and troubleshooting.

Independently plan and execute assigned activities in alignment with project objectives.

Analyse, document and communicate experimental results, both verbally and in writing.

Collaborate with colleagues across R&D, manufacturing and quality control.

Who you are
BSc or MSc in Analytical Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related scientific discipline.

Hands-on experience with biopolymer characterization.

Practical experience with chromatographic methods.

Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

The following qualifications are considered advantageous:

Relevant industrial experience, preferably within life science or a related industry.

Hands-on experience with particle characterization, including particle size distribution (PSD) analysis using digital microscopy and Coulter Counter techniques.

Proficiency in Swedish.

We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on laboratory work and has a genuine interest in analytical science and material characterization.
You are structured, accurate and quality-oriented, with an analytical and solution-focused mindset. You are comfortable taking ownership of your work and performing tasks independently, while also enjoying collaboration across teams and scientific disciplines.
You have a flexible approach and thrive in an R&D environment where scientific curiosity, quality and collaboration are key to success.
Apply
We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait to send in yours. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact Hanna Peterson at SallyQ (hanna.peterson@sallyq.se)

jobs.occupation: We're looking for a Range Creator!

As a Range Creator, you will act as the crucial link between physical product specifications and interactive 3D planning tools. You will configure product behaviors and rules within an internal Range Management System, ensuring digital products function flawlessly for global users.
You are offered
A 12-month full-time consulting contract with a well-known global brand 
Comprehensive onboarding and training to kickstart your career
A collaborative work environment at a modern office in Malmö

This role focuses on data configuration and structuring in a proprietary system to enable accurate digital representation and behavior of products in 3D planners.
Input and configure product data including dimensions, connections, textures, and movement behaviors.  
Structure and organize product data from scratch for new product ranges.  
Solve complex building rules and data discrepancies to ensure correct 3D application behavior.  
Visually verify configuration results in a 3D visualization environment.  
Collaborate closely with product specialists and cross-functional teams to gather necessary product details.  
Participate in team planning, alignment, and collaborative development activities.

Advanced communication skills in English, both written and spoken
Good analytical and logical problem-solving mindset

Strong computer literacy and ability to learn internal web-based systems quickly

Basic knowledge of data structuring, Excel, or JSON structures

Previous experience working within our customer's global retail network

Supportive
Orderly
Responsible
Assertive

OHB Sweden is a leading Swedish supplier of space systems. We develop, build, test and commission satellites and subsystems for a wide range of missions - including communications, Earth observation, and space research and exploration- serving both institutional and commercial customers within and outside Europe.
We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Assurance Manager to join the Quality & Product Assurance team at OHB Sweden.
In this role, you will lead Product Assurance activities within our space projects, ensuring that quality, reliability and product assurance requirements are effectively implemented throughout the project lifecycle. You will work closely with engineering, project management, customers and suppliers, with a direct impact on product quality and mission success. 
Your Role and Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate Product Assurance activities throughout the complete project lifecycle

Define and maintain project Product Assurance plans and ensure compliance with applicable ECSS, customer and company requirements

Act as the main Product Assurance interface towards customers, suppliers and project teams

Support and participate in project reviews, including PDR, CDR, MRR, TRR and acceptance reviews

Manage nonconformances, review boards, root cause investigations and corrective actions

Review and approve PA related documentation, qualification evidence and supplier deliverables

Coordinate Product Assurance disciplines such as EEE, materials and processes, RAMS, software assurance and quality assurance

Perform and support supplier audits, inspections and assessments

Identify product and quality risks and ensure appropriate actions are implemented

Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentoring to other Product Assurance and Quality engineers, consistent with OHB Sweden's senior PA profile.

Your Qualifications
University degree in Engineering or another relevant technical field

5 years minimum of experience in Product Assurance or Quality Assurance within the space industry

Good knowledge of ECSS Product Assurance standards

Experience with space hardware development, manufacturing, integration, testing and qualification

Experience with nonconformance management, root cause analysis and supplier quality assurance

Ability to understand and review complex technical documentation

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Excellent written and spoken English

Who Are We Looking For?

You are an experienced and pragmatic professional who combines strong technical judgement with a collaborative mindset. You are comfortable taking ownership, challenging decisions when necessary and working independently with customers, suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams. 
You bring a risk based and solution-oriented approach to Product Assurance, balancing quality, mission assurance, cost and schedule. 
The position is based at our office in Kista, Stockholm. Travel may be required, primarily within Europe and occasionally to the USA.

jobs.occupation: Take the Next Step in Your Internal Medicine Career
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Are you a specialist in internal medicine with broad clinical competence looking for a long-term hospital position in Sweden?
Dignus Medical is recruiting internal medicine specialists for permanent roles in hospital settings where internal medicine has a central clinical function.
You will work broadly within internal medicine, covering inpatient and outpatient care and managing complex medical conditions across multiple organ systems. 
The work is multidisciplinary, with close collaboration alongside colleagues in geriatrics, cardiology, surgery, and other specialties.
Location and lifestyle
The hospital is located in a scenic part of Sweden known for its forests, lakes, and access to outdoor life throughout the year. The area offers a calm living environment with short commuting distances and easy access to nature, while still providing essential services, schools, and leisure activities.
This setting is well suited for physicians relocating on their own or together with family. Housing is accessible, daily life is structured and predictable, and there are good
opportunities to combine professional work with time for family, outdoor activities, and personal interests.
What Dignus Medical Offers You:
Ongoing support from a dedicated recruiter before, during, and after your employment.
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required.
Help with accommodation and travel arrangements, including support for your family, if necessary.
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype.

Qualifications:
EU-recognized specialist certification in internal medicine
Broad clinical experience within internal medicine
Good communication skills in English
Willingness to learn Swedish

Why Choose Dignus Medical?
We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.
Interested in a career in Sweden?
Let’s talk! Contact us today to learn more about current openings or submit your application. We look forward to helping you take the next step in your internal medicine career.
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

Job Scope 
Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function. 

The Mechanical Technician is directly responsible for preventive and planned maintenance of the stacking and notching tools. The mechanical technician will be responsible for the day-to day hands-on operations including creating work instructions. This role implies responsibility for the quality and workmanship / maintenance of tools and if needed parts that are manufactured. 

Purpose is to support manufacturing operations by performing mechanical, machining, tooling and workshop related activities, ensuring that equipment, tools, fixtures and components are available, functional and meet required quality and safety standards. 

 Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 

During startup phase – assist with department / workshop & stores set up and document creation. 

Carry out planned and preventative maintenance of production dies, tooling, jigs, and fixtures 

Read technical drawings and build tools and assemblies accordingly. 

Operate machines to carry out repairs, modifications, and new parts. 

Precision Grinding of cutting tools. 

Support Engineering requests for tooling related issues improvements. 
Ensure spare parts which are used on tools are booked out and logged in TC (Team Center). 

Suggest design changes for tools and equipment to improve efficiency, quality, Life. 

Inspect components to detect wear, vibrations, or not proper lubrication. 

Assist with department set up to ensure good 5S standards. 

Safety concept as it relates to the material handling equipment or parts storage. 

Train others in maintenance specific tasks. 

Provide regular feedback and participation in departmental meetings. 

The Mechanical Technician will be responsible for the quality and workmanship of the tools they maintain and parts they procedure. 

Together with the rest of the team, being a key player to develop and maintain a good and safe work environment.   

Contribute to the delivery of department objectives. 

Carry out all reasonable request to help the department. 

Requirements 

Educational background and previous experience required for the role 

Mechanical Technical or mechanical machinist background 

 

Qualifications and Experience 

Min. 2 years industrial experience within tool maintenance department 

Good understanding of technical drawings 

Fluency in English 

Good computer literacy 

Excellent MS Office knowledge 

Good understanding of quality and problem-solving tools 

Specific skills & Knowledge  

Good technical knowledge about mechanical, hydraulics, and pneumatics. 

Good knowledge and understanding of limits and fits. 

Working with continuous improvement

jobs.occupation: Balance Your Career and Lifestyle as a Geriatrician in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
We are recruiting an experienced specialist in geriatric medicine for a permanent position at a hospital located in a nature-rich part of Sweden. 
The hospital serves a stable population and provides structured inpatient care for older patients with complex medical needs.
As a geriatrician, you will work with comprehensive geriatric assessment, treatment, and follow-up in close collaboration with internal medicine, rehabilitation services, nursing staff, and allied health professionals. The work is multidisciplinary and focuses on continuity, quality of care, and safe clinical pathways.
Location and lifestyle
The hospital is situated in an area known for forests, lakes, and easy access to outdoor activities throughout the year. Everyday life is calm, commuting times are short, and housing options are accessible. The area offers good conditions for family life, with schools, childcare, and public services within close reach.
This setting is suitable both for physicians relocating on their own and for those moving together with family, offering a stable and predictable everyday environment.
What Dignus Medical Offers You:
Ongoing support from a dedicated recruiter before, during, and after your employment.
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required.
Help with accommodation and travel arrangements, including support for your family, if necessary.
Access to a free language course with a private tutor.

Qualifications:
EU-recognized specialist certification in geriatric medicine
Experience in hospital-based geriatric care
Good communication skills in English

Willingness to learn Swedish

Why Choose Dignus Medical?
We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.
Interested in a career in Sweden?
Let’s talk! Contact us today to learn more about current openings or submit your application. We look forward to helping you take the next step in your internal medicine career.
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

Finance & Compliance Operations Specialist

Join Gigapay and help build the financial and compliance infrastructure behind the creator economy. This is a hands-on operations role with real ownership across payments, bookkeeping, support and compliance, with the opportunity to document and automate how the business scales.

About the role
Gigapay helps brands and agencies work with creators globally in a fast, compliant way and without operational chaos. As a Merchant of Record, we handle onboarding, compliance, reporting and payouts so companies can scale creator programmes across markets.

As our Finance & Compliance Operations Specialist, you will run the daily operational work that keeps payments moving accurately and customers supported. You will match incoming client payments, provide final sign-off on creator payouts, manage balances across accounts and currencies, and resolve exceptions such as failed, reversed or duplicate payouts.

You will also handle support cases within our four-hour response target, support agency onboarding, complete KYC and right-to-work checks, and manage correspondence with Swedish authorities. Alongside daily operations, you will keep bookkeeping and bank reconciliation accurate and turn recurring cases into clear procedures, templates or automations with Tech.

This is not a back-office administration role. You will have direct impact on customer experience, financial accuracy and the operational foundations of an international fintech as it grows.

What we are looking for
Required:
• Ability to work from our office in Gamla Stan, Stockholm, three days per week.
• Hands-on bookkeeping experience, including supplier invoices, transfers between accounts, currency exchanges, bank charges and bank reconciliation.
• Fluent written and spoken Swedish and English.
• Confidence using AI tools, spreadsheets, admin interfaces and a bookkeeping system.

Nice to have:
• Bookkeeping experience in Sweden.
• Experience from fintech, payments, KYC/AML or compliance.
• Experience with multi-currency payments or international banking.
• Professional contact with Swedish government agencies.
• Basic legal or contract-administration experience.

What we offer
Competitive salary plus equity. You will work from our Gamla Stan office in a hybrid setup, three days per week, and gain broad exposure to the engine of a fintech scaling internationally. You will have meaningful ownership over how finance, compliance and operations are documented and improved.

Practical information
Stockholm, hybrid. Full-time, permanent position. Office presence three days per week in Gamla Stan.

Gigapay is partnering with Assistor24 on this hire to keep the process fast and transparent. We review applications as they come in and may hire before the deadline, so apply early.

Are you passionate about turning product and process knowledge into measurable improvements? We are looking for a Manager, Product & Process Improvement (PPI) to join the Product Management team in Sweden.

As Manager PPI, you will lead the team and its portfolio of improvement initiatives, translating business and 4PM priorities into focused technical activities. In addition, you will lead and continuously develop the 4PM forum and its governance, ensuring clear priorities, effective cross-functional alignment, timely decisions and disciplined follow-up. You will work across functions to strengthen product performance, manufacturing processes, specifications and the robustness of our commercial product platforms.

Your role
Lead, develop and empower the PPI team.
Lead and continuously develop the 4PM forum – cross functional forum for live platforms
Manage priorities, resources, budget and delivery across the project portfolio.
Turn business and 4PM priorities into clear technical plans and recommendations.
Drive cross-functional alignment and effective technical risk management.
Ensure robust scientific methods, appropriate test plans & effective technical risk that are applied.
Keep the team’s knowledge of products, processes & technologies connected to business needs.
Build deeper understanding of product, material and process interactions.
Ensure work meets applicable quality, compliance and EHSS requirements.

 
Who are we looking for?
University degree in Engineering, Science or a relevant industry-related discipline; an MBA or PhD is an advantage.
At least 5+ years of experience in Engineering or a Product or Process function.
Strong leadership, communication, collaboration and project-management skills.
Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English.
Beyond the formal requirements, we are looking for someone who is comfortable working across organizational boundaries, can bring structure to complex technical problems and enjoys developing both people and technical capability

This is an opportunity to lead a technical team working directly on the performance and continuous improvement of our commercial product platforms. If you enjoy combining scientific rigor, practical problem-solving and people leadership, this could be a great next step.

Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity:
 Are you an experienced IC Validation Engineer ready to make an impact? Join our dedicated IC validation team within the PEU Silicon. You will play a key role based in Lund Sweden in validating and verifying state-of-art ASIC’s that are shaping the future.
 This opportunity involves the entire process: from developing IC validation frameworks and executing electrical measurements to support product integration.
 We’re looking for a collaborative, solution-oriented team player who’s also self-motivated and ready to mentor others. You approach challenges with an innovative mindset, always open to new ideas and improvements. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of IC validation and thrive in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment, this role is for you!
  
 What you will do:
  Validate high-quality and high-performance IC products to meet rigorous standards, as well as customer expectations.
 Customize test scripts and test programs, specify test boards requirements, and create validation plans for new devices.
 Contribute to bring-up activities for new ICs, including initial manual debugging and investigations.
 Perform core electrical and functional validation measurements over PVT, perform power correlation exercises, and performance testing.
 Troubleshoot technical issues and provide expert customer support when needed.
 Drive continuous improvements in processes, product quality, and validation methods.
 Coordinate the collaborations within global ASIC validation team
  
The skills you bring:
  Extensive experience with at least 6+ years in electrical validation and component-level functional verification, with strong hands-on expertise in lab setups and equipment.
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer or Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent technical field.
 Proficiency in scripting languages like Python, Matlab, and knowledge of programming languages like C and C++. Experience in code repository management Git.
 Deep knowledge of ASICs, FPGAs, and hardware test setups, with proven ability to design and troubleshoot complex validation processes.
 Technical expertise in the technical areas, like SERDES, Ethernet, PCIe, CPRI, DDR, Power, Clock, I3C, etc.
 Strong analytical skills, capable of interpreting validation data, diagnosing issues, and deriving actionable insights to enhance product quality and performance.
 Clear communication skills in both written and spoken English, with an ability to document technical findings effectively and collaborate across teams.
  
 
 Strong plus
  Knowledge of Ericsson ASIC architecture, functionalities
 Experience of design, verification and validation of Ericsson ASIC
 Experience with Ericsson Radio or RAN-Compute HW/SW product development and validation
